page.title: My Balance
page.purpose: Tell a holder what they have, what it is worth to them, and what they did to get it — without showing any of the machinery underneath.

priorities.statement: The current spendable balance is the first thing understood, within one glance and without scrolling.
priorities.notes: This is the only page in the product where a single number dominates. Everything else is subordinate to it.

priorities.statement: The most recent reason the balance changed is visible beside it.
priorities.notes: A balance without its cause is an assertion; the whole premise of the journal is that a holder can see why.

priorities.statement: Reserved balance is distinguishable from spendable balance.
priorities.notes: A holder saving toward a reward must never be surprised that some of their balance will not spend.

priorities.statement: The path to the reward list is obvious and is the single dominant action.

states.description: Holder has a balance and recent history.
Balance and history are being fetched.
Holder exists but has never earned anything; the page explains how earning happens rather than showing a bare zero.
Balance resolved but history failed; the number is shown with an explicit note that history is unavailable.
Displaying a cached balance after a failed refresh, labelled as such rather than presented as current.
Balance could not be loaded; the page says so plainly and offers retry.
No connection; cached balance shown with an unambiguous offline indicator.
The authenticated holder does not match the requested holder; no data of any kind is rendered.

elements.name: Spendable balance
elements.description: The dominant number: what this holder can spend right now.

elements.name: Reserved balance
elements.description: Amount held for a pending redemption or a savings goal.

elements.name: Recent activity
elements.description: The last few events with the reason each one happened.

elements.name: See what I can get
elements.description: The single dominant action leading to the reward list.

elements.name: Token symbol
elements.description: The minter-defined symbol and color that give this economy its identity.

claims.statement: The spendable balance is fully visible without scrolling on a mobile viewport.
Exactly one primary action is offered on this page: going to the reward list.
Balance is read before reserved balance, which is read before recent activity.
The empty state explains how tokens are earned instead of rendering a bare zero.
A stale cached balance is visually and textually distinguishable from a freshly loaded one.
Reserved versus spendable is conveyed by label and shape, never by color alone.
Every interactive element is reachable and operable by keyboard alone.
The permission-denied state renders no balance, no name, and no indication whether the requested holder exists.
